title: Ana's House
text:
My friend Ana has a small house. It is yellow and has a big green door. The kitchen is bright and clean.

Her cat is black and very soft. It likes to sleep on the blue sofa. Ana loves her quiet house.

questions.text: How does Ana probably feel about her house?
Why is the cat probably happy?
options: It has a comfortable place to sleep
It is outside in the rain
It is alone at the door

paragraph_translations: Minha amiga Ana tem uma casa pequena. Ela é amarela e tem uma porta verde grande. A cozinha é clara e limpa.
O gato dela é preto e muito macio. Ele gosta de dormir no sofá azul. Ana adora a sua casa tranquila.
